en.description:
88 Blessings: The slot machine that lives on your wrist.
Spin with the Digital Crown. Feel every win tap your skin.
A round takes ten seconds. No iPhone needed.

They say 8 is the luckiest number, and 88 Blessings gives you two. A real 3x3 slot machine with 5 paylines, built for Apple Watch from the first pixel, not shrunk down from a phone.

SPIN WITH THE DIGITAL CROWN
Turn the crown and the reels turn with it. Cherries, bells, diamonds and lucky sevens land with a click of the Taptic Engine, so you feel each reel stop before you see it.

A SCRATCH CARD EVERY DAY
Come back each morning and scratch a foil ticket with your finger. Play several days in a row and the prize climbs, up to 5x on a lucky ticket.

THREE SCATTERS, FIVE FREE SPINS
Land 3 Scatters and the machine pays for your next 5 spins. Wilds step in to complete your paylines along the way.

NEVER STUCK AT ZERO
Ran your balance dry? Once a day the machine spots you enough coins to spin again. Your day never ends on an empty pocket.

MADE FOR THE MOMENTS BETWEEN
The coffee line. The elevator. The last minute before a meeting. Raise your wrist, spin, drop your arm. Progress saves itself the instant the reels stop.

FEATURES
• A real slot machine built only for Apple Watch, no iPhone required
• Spin by tapping the reels or turning the Digital Crown
• 3x3 reels, 5 paylines, classic symbols with Wilds and Scatters
• 3 Scatters award 5 free spins
• Daily scratch-card bonus that grows with your streak
• A once-a-day coin rescue when you hit zero
• Haptic feedback for every reel stop and win, with an off switch
• Bets from 5 to 100 coins
• Automatic saving and Reduce Motion support

88 Blessings is free to play and intended for entertainment only. It offers no real-money gambling, cash prizes, or real-world rewards.


Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://telegra.ph/Privacy-Policy-07-14-109
en.releaseNotes:
- Daily bonus is now a scratch ticket. Rub off the foil, collect the prize.
- New second page: swipe left for the paytable, the rules, and a sound and haptics switch.
- Two new symbols: the horseshoe and the gold bar.
- Fixed: swiping no longer spins the reels by accident.
- Fixed: the scratch ticket fits every watch size.
en.subtitle: 777 Vegas Spin & Jackpot Game
